1:1.web: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
1:1.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

1:2.web: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
1:2.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

1:3.web: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
1:3.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

1:4.web: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
1:4.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

1:5.web: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;
1:5.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

1:6.web: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
1:6.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

1:7.web: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1:7.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1:8.web: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
1:8.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

1:9.web: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
1:9.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

1:10.web: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
1:10.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

1:11.web: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
1:11.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

1:12.web: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
1:12.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

1:13.web: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
1:13.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

1:14.web: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
1:14.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

1:15.web: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
1:15.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

1:16.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
1:16.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

1:17.web: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
1:17.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

1:18.web: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
1:18.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

1:19.web: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
1:19.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

1:20.web: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.
1:20.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

1:21.web: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
1:21.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

1:22.web: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
1:22.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

1:23.web: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.
1:23.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

1:24.web: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
1:24.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

1:25.web: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
1:25.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

1:26.web: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
1:26.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

1:27.web: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
1:27.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

1:28.web: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
1:28.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

1:29.web: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
1:29.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

1:30.web: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
1:30.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

1:31.web: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
1:31.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

1:32.web: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
1:32.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

2:1.web: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
2:1.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

2:2.web: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
2:2.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

2:3.web: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
2:3.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

2:4.web: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
2:4.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

2:5.web: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;
2:5.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

2:6.web: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
2:6.kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

2:7.web: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
2:7.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

2:8.web: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,
2:8.kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

2:9.web: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
2:9.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

2:10.web: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
2:10.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

2:11.web: For there is no partiality with God.
2:11.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.

2:12.web: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
2:12.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

2:13.web: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
2:13.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

2:14.web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
2:14.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

2:15.web: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
2:15.kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

2:16.web: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
2:16.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

2:17.web: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,
2:17.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

2:18.web: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
2:18.kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

2:19.web: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
2:19.kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

2:20.web: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
2:20.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

2:21.web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
2:21.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

2:22.web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
2:22.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

2:23.web: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
2:23.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

2:24.web: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
2:24.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

2:25.web: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
2:25.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

bsb: a man who is not circumcised
2:26.web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
2:26.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

2:27.web: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
2:27.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

2:28.web: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
2:28.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

2:29.web: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
2:29.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

3:1.web: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
3:1.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

3:2.web: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
3:2.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

3:3.web: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
3:3.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

3:4.web: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
3:4.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

3:5.web: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
3:5.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

3:6.web: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
3:6.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

3:7.web: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
3:7.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

3:8.web: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let us do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
3:8.kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

bsb: we have already made the charge
3:9.web: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.
3:9.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

3:10.web: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
3:10.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

3:11.web: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
3:11.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

3:12.web: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
3:12.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

3:13.web: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips”;
3:13.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

3:14.web: “whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
3:14.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

3:15.web: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
3:15.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

3:16.web: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
3:16.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

3:17.web: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
3:17.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:

3:18.web: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
3:18.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

3:19.web: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
3:19.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

3:20.web: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
3:20.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

3:21.web: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
3:21.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

3:22.web: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
3:22.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

3:23.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
3:23.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

3:24.web: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
3:24.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

3:25.web: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
3:25.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

3:26.web: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
3:26.kjv: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

3:27.web: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
3:27.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

3:28.web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
3:28.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

3:29.web: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
3:29.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

3:30.web: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.
3:30.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

3:31.web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
3:31.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

4:1.web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
4:1.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

4:2.web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
4:2.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

4:3.web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
4:3.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

4:4.web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
4:4.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

4:5.web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
4:5.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

4:6.web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,
4:6.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

4:7.web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
4:7.kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

4:8.web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
4:8.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

4:9.web: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
4:9.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

4:10.web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
4:10.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

4:11.web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
4:11.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

4:12.web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
4:12.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

4:13.web: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
4:13.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

4:14.web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
4:14.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

4:15.web: For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
4:15.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

4:16.web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
4:16.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

bsb: He is our father in the presence of
4:17.web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
4:17.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

4:18.web: Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
4:18.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

4:19.web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
4:19.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah’s womb:

4:20.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
4:20.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

4:21.web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
4:21.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

4:22.web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
4:22.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

4:23.web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
4:23.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

4:24.web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,
4:24.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

4:25.web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
4:25.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

5:1.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
5:1.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

5:2.web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
5:2.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

5:3.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
5:3.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

5:4.web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
5:4.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

5:5.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
5:5.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

5:6.web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
5:6.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

5:7.web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
5:7.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

5:8.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
5:8.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

bsb: since we have now been justified
5:9.web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
5:9.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

5:10.web: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
5:10.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

5:11.web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
5:11.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

5:12.web: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.
5:12.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

5:13.web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
5:13.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

5:14.web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
5:14.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

5:15.web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
5:15.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

5:16.web: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
5:16.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

5:17.web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
5:17.kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

5:18.web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
5:18.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

5:19.web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
5:19.kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

5:20.web: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
5:20.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

5:21.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
5:21.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

6:1.web: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
6:1.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

6:2.web: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
6:2.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

6:3.web: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
6:3.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

6:4.web: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
6:4.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

bsb: we will certainly also be united with Him
6:5.web: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
6:5.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

6:6.web: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
6:6.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

6:7.web: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
6:7.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

6:8.web: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;
6:8.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

6:9.web: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!
6:9.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

6:10.web: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
6:10.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

6:11.web: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6:11.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

6:12.web: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
6:12.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

6:13.web: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
6:13.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

6:14.web: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.
6:14.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

6:15.web: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!
6:15.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

6:16.web: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
6:16.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

6:17.web: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
6:17.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

6:18.web: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
6:18.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

6:19.web: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
6:19.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

6:20.web: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.
6:20.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

6:21.web: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
6:21.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

6:22.web: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.
6:22.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

6:23.web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6:23.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

7:1.web: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
7:1.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

7:2.web: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
7:2.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

7:3.web: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
7:3.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

7:4.web: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
7:4.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

7:5.web: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
7:5.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

7:6.web: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
7:6.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

bsb: I would not have been mindful of
I would not have been aware of
7:7.web: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
7:7.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

7:8.web: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
7:8.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

7:9.web: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
7:9.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

7:10.web: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;
7:10.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

7:11.web: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
7:11.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

7:12.web: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
7:12.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

7:13.web: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
7:13.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

7:14.web: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
7:14.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

7:15.web: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
7:15.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

bsb: I do not want to do,
7:16.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
7:16.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

7:17.web: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
7:17.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

7:18.web: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
7:18.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

bsb: I do not want to do.
7:19.web: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
7:19.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

7:20.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
7:20.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

7:21.web: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
7:21.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

7:22.web: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
7:22.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

7:23.web: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
7:23.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

7:24.web: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
7:24.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

7:25.web: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.
7:25.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

8:1.web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
8:1.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

8:2.web: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
8:2.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

8:3.web: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;
8:3.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

8:4.web: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8:4.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

bsb: set their minds on the things of the
8:5.web: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
8:5.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

8:6.web: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
8:6.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

8:7.web: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
8:7.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

8:8.web: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
8:8.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

8:9.web: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
8:9.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

8:10.web: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
8:10.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

8:11.web: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
8:11.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

8:12.web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
8:12.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

8:13.web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
8:13.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

8:14.web: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
8:14.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

8:15.web: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
8:15.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

8:16.web: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
8:16.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

bsb: we may also be glorified with Him.
8:17.web: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
8:17.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

8:18.web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
8:18.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

8:19.web: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
8:19.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

8:20.web: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
8:20.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

8:21.web: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
8:21.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

8:22.web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
8:22.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

8:23.web: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
8:23.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

8:24.web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
8:24.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

8:25.web: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
8:25.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

8:26.web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
8:26.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

8:27.web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
8:27.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

8:28.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
8:28.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

8:29.web: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
8:29.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

8:30.web: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
8:30.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

8:31.web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
8:31.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

8:32.web: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
8:32.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

8:33.web: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
8:33.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth.

8:34.web: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
8:34.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

8:35.web: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
8:35.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

8:36.web: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
8:36.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

8:37.web: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
8:37.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

8:38.web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
8:38.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

8:39.web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
8:39.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

9:1.web: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,
9:1.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

9:2.web: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
9:2.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

9:3.web: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh,
9:3.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

9:4.web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
9:4.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

9:5.web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
9:5.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

9:6.web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.
9:6.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

9:7.web: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
9:7.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

9:8.web: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
9:8.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

9:9.web: For this is a word of promise, “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
9:9.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.

9:10.web: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
9:10.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

9:11.web: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
9:11.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

9:12.web: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
9:12.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

9:13.web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
9:13.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

9:14.web: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
9:14.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

9:15.web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
9:15.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

9:16.web: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
9:16.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

9:17.web: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
9:17.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

9:18.web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
9:18.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

9:19.web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
9:19.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

9:20.web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
9:20.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

9:21.web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
9:21.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

9:22.web: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
9:22.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

9:23.web: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
9:23.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

9:24.web: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
9:24.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

9:25.web: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
9:25.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

9:26.web: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ There they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
9:26.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

9:27.web: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
9:27.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

9:28.web: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth.”
9:28.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

9:29.web: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
9:29.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

9:30.web: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
9:30.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

9:31.web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
9:31.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

9:32.web: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
9:32.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

bsb: will never be put to shame.”
9:33.web: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
9:33.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

10:1.web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
10:1.kjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

10:2.web: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
10:2.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

10:3.web: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
10:3.kjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

10:4.web: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
10:4.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

10:5.web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
10:5.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

10:6.web: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
10:6.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

10:7.web: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
10:7.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

10:8.web: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart”; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:
10:8.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

10:9.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
10:9.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

10:10.web: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
10:10.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

10:11.web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
10:11.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

10:12.web: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
10:12.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

10:13.web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
10:13.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

bsb: in whom they have not believed?
can they believe in the One
10:14.web: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
10:14.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

10:15.web: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
10:15.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

10:16.web: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
10:16.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

10:17.web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
10:17.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

10:18.web: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
10:18.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

10:19.web: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.”
10:19.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

10:20.web: Isaiah is very bold, and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
10:20.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

10:21.web: But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
10:21.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

11:1.web: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
11:1.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

11:2.web: God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
11:2.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,

11:3.web: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
11:3.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

11:4.web: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
11:4.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

11:5.web: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
11:5.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

11:6.web: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
11:6.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

11:7.web: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
11:7.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

11:8.web: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
11:8.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

11:9.web: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
11:9.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

11:10.web: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.”
11:10.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

11:11.web: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
11:11.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

11:12.web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
11:12.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

11:13.web: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
11:13.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

11:14.web: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
11:14.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

11:15.web: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
11:15.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

11:16.web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
11:16.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

11:17.web: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;
11:17.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

11:18.web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
11:18.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

11:19.web: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
11:19.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

11:20.web: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
11:20.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

11:21.web: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
11:21.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

11:22.web: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
11:22.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

11:23.web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
11:23.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

11:24.web: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
11:24.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

11:25.web: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
11:25.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

11:26.web: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
11:26.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

11:27.web: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
11:27.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

11:28.web: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
11:28.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.

11:29.web: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
11:29.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

11:30.web: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
11:30.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

11:31.web: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
11:31.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

11:32.web: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
11:32.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

11:33.web: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
11:33.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

11:34.web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
11:34.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

11:35.web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
11:35.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
