11:36.web: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
11:36.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

12:1.web: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
12:1.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

bsb: will be able to test and approve
12:2.web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
12:2.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

12:3.web: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
12:3.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

12:4.web: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
12:4.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

12:5.web: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.
12:5.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

12:6.web: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
12:6.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

12:7.web: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
12:7.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

12:8.web: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
12:8.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

12:9.web: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
12:9.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

12:10.web: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
12:10.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

12:11.web: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
12:11.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

12:12.web: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;
12:12.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

12:13.web: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.
12:13.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

12:14.web: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
12:14.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

12:15.web: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
12:15.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

12:16.web: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
12:16.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

12:17.web: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
12:17.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

12:18.web: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
12:18.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

12:19.web: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
12:19.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

12:20.web: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
12:20.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

12:21.web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
12:21.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

13:1.web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
13:1.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

13:2.web: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
13:2.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

13:3.web: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,
13:3.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

13:4.web: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
13:4.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

13:5.web: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
13:5.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

13:6.web: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, attending continually on this very thing.
13:6.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

13:7.web: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
13:7.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

13:8.web: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
13:8.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

13:9.web: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
13:9.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

13:10.web: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
13:10.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

13:11.web: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
13:11.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

13:12.web: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
13:12.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

13:13.web: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
13:13.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

13:14.web: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
13:14.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

14:1.web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
14:1.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

14:2.web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
14:2.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

14:3.web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
14:3.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

14:4.web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
14:4.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

14:5.web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
14:5.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

14:6.web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
14:6.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

14:7.web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
14:7.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

14:8.web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
14:8.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.

bsb: He might be the Lord of
14:9.web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
14:9.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

14:10.web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
14:10.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

14:11.web: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
14:11.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

14:12.web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
14:12.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

14:13.web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
14:13.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.

14:14.web: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
14:14.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

14:15.web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
14:15.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

bsb: to be spoken of as evil.
14:16.web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
14:16.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

14:17.web: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
14:17.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

14:18.web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
14:18.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

14:19.web: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
14:19.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

14:20.web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
14:20.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

14:21.web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
14:21.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

14:22.web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
14:22.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

14:23.web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
14:23.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

14:24.web: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

14:25.web: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

14:26.web: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

15:1.web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
15:1.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

15:2.web: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
15:2.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

15:3.web: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
15:3.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

15:4.web: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
15:4.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

15:5.web: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,
15:5.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

15:6.web: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15:6.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15:7.web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
15:7.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

15:8.web: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
15:8.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

15:9.web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.”
15:9.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

15:10.web: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
15:10.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

15:11.web: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
15:11.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

15:12.web: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
15:12.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

15:13.web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
15:13.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

15:14.web: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
15:14.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

15:15.web: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
15:15.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

15:16.web: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
15:16.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

15:17.web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
15:17.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

15:18.web: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
15:18.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

15:19.web: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
15:19.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

15:20.web: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
15:20.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

15:21.web: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
15:21.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

15:22.web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
15:22.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

15:23.web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
15:23.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

15:24.web: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
15:24.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

15:25.web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
15:25.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

15:26.web: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
15:26.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

bsb: They were pleased to do it,
15:27.web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.
15:27.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

15:28.web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
15:28.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

15:29.web: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
15:29.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

bsb: to join me in my struggle
15:30.web: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
15:30.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

15:31.web: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
15:31.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

bsb: and together with you be refreshed.
15:32.web: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
15:32.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

15:33.web: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
15:33.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

16:1.web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
16:1.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

16:2.web: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
16:2.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

16:3.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
16:3.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

16:4.web: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
16:4.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

16:5.web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
16:5.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

16:6.web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
16:6.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

16:7.web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
16:7.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

16:8.web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
16:8.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

16:9.web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
16:9.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

16:10.web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
16:10.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.

16:11.web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
16:11.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

16:12.web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
16:12.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

bsb: who has been a mother to me
16:13.web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
16:13.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

16:14.web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
16:14.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

16:15.web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
16:15.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

16:16.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
16:16.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

16:17.web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
16:17.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

16:18.web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
16:18.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

16:19.web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
16:19.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

16:20.web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16:20.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

16:21.web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
16:21.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

16:22.web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
16:22.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

16:23.web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
16:23.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

16:24.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
16:24.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

16:25.kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

16:26.kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

16:27.kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
